body:
> From the second-pass review of PR #178 (#163, merged 2026-08-29). The blocker is fixed and verified; these are the leftovers.

## What

1. **Suppression bound is per attempt lifetime, docs say consecutive** (`src/hook.js` ~186 `readAgentCounts`, `src/model.js` ~530 `shouldNudgeOnStop`, `docs/wiki/concepts/worker-identity.md`). Measured: a file `S X X X X E S` (wave 1 done, wave 2 out) nudges — the four old `X` lines still count, so a track root that fans out five or more waves gets the false nudge back on wave 5. Reset `suppressed` on every `E` line (consecutive semantics), or change the three places that say "in a row"/"consecutive" to "per attempt". Test: the `S X X X X E S` fixture stands aside.
2. **Look up `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` first when it is set and differs from `ctx.root`** (`src/hook.js` ~416 `subagentStopHook`): that is the definition of "I am in a child checkout". Today the cwd is tried first, so (a) on a `claude-p` child every SubagentStop prints a false `…; ignoring` leak line (two lines when the leaked env points at the board root), and (b) a child checkout with no `.kanban/board.json` trusts the inherited env and records `E` into the child's own `.kanban/`, never the root's — the original blocker on that edge. Add the inherited-env child case to `test/hook.test.js` (the existing test deletes KB_* before firing).
3. **Docs still say two hooks**: `docs/harnesses.md` ~324 ("only one of them is live" — SubagentStop is live on both profiles), ~398, ~425; `docs/manual-mode.md` ~14, ~21; `docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md` ~42, ~176; comments `src/init.js` ~176, `src/board.js` ~43.
4. **Wiki**: no page for the new hook — either a short `features/subagent-stop.md` or say in `worker-identity.md`'s header that it is the page; re-stamp `hook-install-shapes.md`, `operator-seat.md`, `review-loop.md`, `up-and-down.md`, `web-board.md` (stale from #178's init.js/doctor.js/model.js/cli.js edits).
5. State the design dependency on the card and in worker-identity.md: the fix rests on `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` inside the child hook being the root's `kb-<n>-<k>` checkout (spike-measured on 2.1.251); nothing else catches it (b-neg probe: without it, `E` is never recorded).

## Done when

- `S X X X X E S` → stand aside (test); a claude-p child with inherited KB_* and no board.json records `E` in the root with no leak line (test).
- `grep -rn "two hooks\|Stop and PreToolUse"` finds nothing that omits SubagentStop.
- wiki-check back to the baseline or better. `npm run lint && npm test` green.
goal: A track root is nudged only when its subagents are all done or the suppression bound was hit consecutively, a child checkout always records into the root, and every doc names the three hooks
title: SubagentStop counters: consecutive suppression bound, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR looked up first in a child checkout, and the hook docs say three hooks
